notes: New (Premium): Dial-a-Date. Pick the month you want to be debt-free, and the app calculates the exact extra monthly payment it takes to hit it - then lets you apply it to your plan in one tap. Find it right under your Freedom Date.
New (Free): True Cost. Every debt now shows what it really costs you - the interest you're paying per day, and the total interest you'd hand over if you only ever paid the minimum.
